segments.name: Biotechnology
segments.description: A clinical-stage biotechnology company developing novel gene therapies, biologics and vaccines for inherited retinal diseases and blindness.
segments.evidence: Ocugen is aiming to redefine the future of vision through game-changing gene therapies with the potential to address significant, unmet medical needs.

revenueModel.text: The company has generated no product revenue; its only revenue is collaborative arrangement revenue from fulfilling terms of a collaboration agreement.
revenueModel.evidence: We have not generated revenue from our product candidates to date and have incurred net losses in each year since inception.
